lines.text: Please send me the notes ASAP.

data.define: Short for "as soon as possible"; used to ask for something quickly.

example.text: Please send me the notes ASAP.

misuse.text: Don't write 'ASAP' to your boss rudely.

data.l1: في أسرع وقت ممكن; بأسرع ما يمكن

native.tip: “ASAP” = في أسرع وقت ممكن; بأسرع ما يمكن. مثال: “Please send me the notes ASAP.”
native.caption:
ما معنى “ASAP”؟
“ASAP” = في أسرع وقت ممكن; بأسرع ما يمكن.
مثال: “Please send me the notes ASAP.” (من فضلك أرسل لي الملاحظات "ASAP".)
